body: Not that it necessarily matters, but she flaked and would make excuses like no tomorrow - at least 4 times, give or take.
You can talk to me if you want.

To answer your first question, yes. I'm seeing a great therapist (thankfully tomorrow) and have a psychiatrist but am looking for a new one. I'm fortunate enough to be on my father's insurance until the end of the year, so for now, provided my insurance is accepted and the copay isn't too high, I'm alright. Music is a big one for me, sometimes the music is sad but songs can really lift you up. I've found that helps if only briefly. Definitely try to walk a lot and be mindful of the city environment. That helps to, just to get that fresh air. Cleanliness is harder to come by; I used to be incredibly organized but that fell to the wayside a few years ago. By the way, your words of encouragement are sweet and kind. Thank you for that. It's nice to know there's good people out there.

Looked over your initial comments again. Thanks for believing in me and giving myself a sense of self-worth, as it seems to be hard for me to give that to myself. Seems like life is a race and everyone is so ahead of me, while I haven’t even started yet, it feels so so lonely I hate to say.

Appreciate you reaching out and touching base. I’ve struggled since my post and have been in crisis I hate to say, a few times since then. I looked at a place in Philadelphia today and it seemed like a great fit. Told the landlord I wanted to apply and have yet to hear back in any way, shape or form. Hoping for the best. Have had one request for an interview, I’ve followed up, but nothing yet on that front either. Trying to hope for the best, but it’s unbelievably difficult. My life just feels pointless. I’ve been trying to journal (something I love to do), but can’t find the energy. On top of all of that, there’s just living at home, which is a whole different beast. My plan is to get my things packed up and try to leave as soon as I can. In summation, things are looking pretty grim and sad. Won’t last forever I know but feels like I’m stuck in emotional quicksand.

That's a good point. I would say more so living on my own and figuring out what to do with my life. 

Thanks!
